name: Federal civil filings by nature of suit and district, 12-month periods since 2018
description: How many civil cases were filed in each of the 94 U.S. district courts and nationwide, by nature of suit, from the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts' Statistical Tables for the Federal Judiciary: Table C-3 (the 94 districts by case type: contract, real property, torts, civil rights, prisoner petitions, labor, Social Security, intellectual property and more, U.S. cases and private cases) and Table C-2 (the nation by about 100 natures of suit, such as product liability, medical malpractice, employment, the Fair Labor Standards Act, ERISA and consumer credit, with the basis of jurisdiction). One record per district and case type for the latest 12 months, with the year before and the history of every earlier table, and one record per nature of suit nationwide. In every table the 94 districts add up exactly to the national Total row, every circuit adds up to its districts and every nature-of-suit group adds up to the rows under it. Counts only: no lawyer or firm is listed or ranked.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Federal civil filings by nature of suit and district, 12-month periods since 2018 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963129
keywords: Statistical Tables for the Federal Judiciary

distribution.name: civil-filings.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: civil-filings.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: civil-filings-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in civil-filings-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to civil-filings.csv on id.

recordSet.name: civil-filings
recordSet.description: The records of Federal civil filings by nature of suit and district, 12-month periods since 2018, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: district
field.description: The district's code (two or three letters: CAC is the Central District of California, NJ is the District of New Jersey) or US for the nation

field.name: districtName
field.description: The district's name

field.name: table
field.description: C-3 (by district) or C-2 (national, by nature of suit)

field.name: category
field.description: The case type: a Table C-3 column id (for example priv-motor-vehicle-pi) or a Table C-2 row id (for example health-care-pharma)

field.name: categoryLabel
field.description: The case type as the table prints it

field.name: group
field.description: all, us (the U.S. government is a party), priv (private cases) or nos (a Table C-2 nature-of-suit row)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: The machine value (see unit)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: periodEnd
field.description: The last day of the 12-month period (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: priorValue
field.description: The count for the 12 months ending a year earlier; empty when that table is not in the series

field.name: yoyChange
field.description: This period's count minus the prior one

field.name: comparePeriod
field.description: The period end of the prior count

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: note
field.description: Caveats

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
